invariants.statement: Every clone page renders with zero runtime requests to non-local origins; all assets are vendored under clone/static/.
Protected /my-jefit routes redirect anonymous browsers to /login?redirect=<path>; authenticated visits to /login redirect to /my-jefit; sessions are __Host- cookies via the site backend.

The Elite upgrade consumes a local-sandbox payment approval and writes the subscription order and membership state in one SQLite transaction; declined creates nothing; retryable succeeds only on retry; duplicate submission is idempotent.
The clone-local checkout accepts only opaque sandbox scenario IDs; no card number, CVC, expiry, or bank field value is ever accepted, stored, or logged by the backend.
A member's routines, workout logs, body stats, and membership state are invisible to and unmodifiable by any other member or anonymous visitor.
Resetting and reseeding the database yields byte-stable business state: same catalog, same seeded accounts, same seeded routine/log fixtures.

Create Plan creates a plan server-side immediately and opens the autosaving editor; added exercises default to 3 sets of 10 lbs x 8 with 60s rest; set edits persist; an emptied routine name is silently ignored exactly as on source.

'+ Add session' creates a session for the selected day; adding an exercise logs a default set; the persisted Training Summary shows timers, completion count, volume, and per-set rows; days without sessions show the 'No logs' empty state.
Unknown paths return an unbranded server-style 404 (title '404 Not Found', 'Not Found / The requested URL was not found on this server.') without site chrome, matching source behavior.
Registration-verification and password-reset mail exist only through the site-backend seam purposes (local outbox in offline profiles); OTP/reset secrets are never stored in plaintext or logged.
Free accounts see 'Account Type: Free' with upgrade cards and the 'Create custom exercise (0/3)' limit; Elite-gated affordances render exactly as observed for the free role.
